fixtures.env: Robin E0 solo vs 3 Physical-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles — A2 advances Robin 25% at battle start (harmony.ts:1634-1635) and Talent 130904 grants +20% CRIT DMG; Ultimate 130903 opens the Concerto state with a SPD-90 Concerto Countdown; with no ally attackers, Vox Harmonique Additional DMG and the talent's +2 Energy regen never fire, and Robin's own scheduled Concerto basics deal no damage (perform early-return harmony.ts:1681)

Robin E0 with Sushang (kitId sushang) vs 3 Physical-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles — Skill 130902 'Pinion's Aria' grants all allies +50% DMG for 3 turns (duration ticks on Robin's turns, harmony.ts:1710-1713) and is re-cast on expiry; Ultimate 130903 Concerto makes Sushang act immediately (harmony.ts:1702-1703) and Robin's Vox Harmonique Additional DMG fires once per Sushang attack; countdown end gives Robin an immediate action (harmony.ts:1674-1677)

requirements.claim: Solo Robin casts Skill 130902 'Pinion's Aria' 4 times in 3 cycles (decide harmony.ts:1645 prefers Skill while SP >= 1 and skillPriority > 0).

4 scheduled basic actions in the solo battle — 2 outside Concerto that hit, 2 taken during Concerto where perform() early-returns (harmony.ts:1681 'rt.concerto -> return', canon 130903 'cannot enter her turn or take action').

Ultimate 130903 fires exactly once in both fixtures: decide() opens with ult at full Energy 160 (harmony.ts:1684 gate via decide), the kit zeroes the pool (harmony.ts:1685), and 160 Energy regens only once in 3 cycles.

Basic 130901 'Wingflip White Noise' is a 3-hit attack (canon 130901 notes 'dealt in 3 hits ... 33% + 33% + 34%'; harmony.ts:1725 split [0.33,0.33,0.34]) — only the 2 post-Concerto basics hit, so 6 hits solo.
4 Skill casts in the team battle, same cadence as solo (Aria expires 3 Robin-turns after each cast, harmony.ts:1710-1713 tickOnSource).
3 scheduled basic actions in the team battle — only T17 lands outside Concerto (T10/T15 fall inside the Concerto window).

While Concerto is active, each ally attack triggers one 'Vox Harmonique (Additional)' hit by Robin, deduplicated per attackNo (harmony.ts:1658-1667, canon 130903 'after every attack by ally targets ... for 1 time') — 4 procs off Sushang's attacks in 3 cycles.
Solo negative: no Vox Harmonique Additional DMG ever fires — the Concerto hook requires an attacking ally other than Robin (harmony.ts:1654-1658 attacker !== robin), and solo has none.

ENERGY_LOSS reason 'ult_cost' books amount 160 = the full pool (energyMax 160, harmony.ts:1630; kit zeroes Energy harmony.ts:1685 and adds none during the cast, so the TurnManager.ts:372-374 delta is exactly 160) — both fixtures.
The paid Ultimate cast grants the generic castUlt +5 Energy refund to Robin (TurnManager.ts:375).
The Skill regenerates 30 Energy (harmony.ts:1709 sim.gainEnergy(u, 30)) and is each battle's first Robin Energy gain (80 -> 110).
Trace A6 Sequential Passage adds +5 Energy on every Skill (harmony.ts:1715-1716, comment 'A6') — 4 team Skill casts => 4 gains of n=5 sourced from Robin.

Basic regenerates 20 Energy (harmony.ts:1723); Concerto basics grant nothing (early return harmony.ts:1681) and each fixture's second free basic clips against the 160 cap (actual delta 5), leaving exactly one observable n=20 gain per fixture.
Pinion's Aria grants +50% All-Type DMG (canon 130902 level-10 param #1 = 0.5; harmony.ts:1713 mods dmgAll on robin_aria).
Talent Tonal Resonance grants all allies +20% CRIT DMG with permanent duration (canon 130904 level-10 param #1 = 0.2; harmony.ts:1637-1640 turns: Infinity, applied at battle start).
Each Skill cast spends 1 SP (harmony.ts:1708 sim.spendSp(1)) — 4 casts => 4 SP_LOSS events, both fixtures.
Basic spends no SP and returns +1 (harmony.ts:1722 sim.gainSp(1)); Concerto basics grant nothing (harmony.ts:1681), so only the 2 post-Concerto solo basics produce SP_GAIN events.
Skill resolution order: ABILITY_USED fires when the action starts, then perform() spends SP (harmony.ts:1708) and applies robin_aria (harmony.ts:1713).
The Skill's +30 Energy (harmony.ts:1709) is granted before the 'uses Pinion's Aria' note is logged (harmony.ts:1717).
Ultimate resolution order: concertoBuffs applies robin_concerto to allies (harmony.ts:1690) before the Concerto Countdown unit is registered (harmony.ts:1692-1699).
TurnManager.ts:374 emits ENERGY_LOSS 'ult_cost' before TurnManager.ts:375 grants the +5 refund.

Pinion's Aria lands on every ally, incl. Sushang, for 3 turns with duration ticking on Robin's turns (harmony.ts:1711-1713 tickOnSource, canon 130902 'duration decreases by 1 at the start of Robin's every turn').
Every Skill cast logs 'uses Pinion's Aria (team DMG+)' (harmony.ts:1717) — 4 notes in each fixture.
The Talent's CRIT DMG buff is applied to every living ally, not just Robin (harmony.ts:1637-1640 loop over allies; team fixture shows robin_cd on both Robin and Sushang).

Casting the Ultimate immediately queues Sushang's action (harmony.ts:1701-1703 sim.immediateTurn for every other ally, canon 130903 'makes all teammates ... immediately take action') — Sushang receives 3 EXTRA_TURN events (Concerto queue + her own Dawn Herald follow-ups) across the battle.
Solo negative: the Talent's +2 Energy regen never fires — harmony.ts:1654 requires the attacker to be an ally other than Robin, and solo has none, so no n=2 ENERGY_GAIN event exists.
